nodes.text: @LasVegasLocally I got tested with all the flu symptoms and it came back negative. 102.3 fever, body aches and terrible wheezing cough. It lasted about 5 days. The doctor told me it might be this: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV). I think the test was just wrong.
